description: Calculate French income tax (IR) 2026 on 2025 income per Article 197 CGI: progressive brackets with family quotient, family-quotient cap (1,807 EUR per extra half-share beyond 1 share single / 2 shares couple, 903.50 EUR per quarter share) and décote (897 EUR single / 1,483 EUR couple minus 45.25% of tax). Not implemented: the 4,262 EUR cap for single parents (parent isolé) and the special 1,079 / 1,801 EUR cases of art. 197 I-2; DOM reductions. Returns: {income, family_quotient, tax_before_cap, qf_cap, tax_after_cap, decote, total_tax, effective_rate_pct, marginal_rate_pct, brackets}. See list_bundles for related 'finance-france' calculators.

couple.description: true = joint taxation (married/PACS couple, base 2 shares); false = individual taxation (base 1 share)

income.description: Annual net taxable income in euros

parts.description: Number of fiscal shares (1=single, 2=married, +0.5 per child)
